$comment: NEUTRAL PLACEHOLDER VALUES. This file is the single source of brand values for the agent team (the deliverable-review skill reads brand values from here and nowhere else). Run the brand-extract skill to replace it with values learned from your own collateral; it regenerates brand/tokens.css alongside it and writes the brand-extract skill.

status.$comment: Optional functional status colors. Left empty in the placeholder; when empty, reviewers accept a conventional red, amber, or green used strictly as a status cue and kept off primary brand elements.

fonts.$comment: web is a CSS font stack for HTML and SVG output. office is a single installed face for .pptx, .docx and .xlsx, which cannot use a fallback stack.
fonts.web: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

avoid: colors not listed in this file
